notes.title: Necroking is now available!
notes.content:
Necroking has officially emerged from the shadows and is now live on Windows and macOS! 

The world is crumbling under chaos. Cities are rotting and the living dare to stand in your way. But fear not, because you are the Necroking – master of the undead, wielder of dark magic, and bringer of doom. It’s time to raise your army and show the world what real power looks like! 

[previewyoutube=mZ1W5iGz0MU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What awaits you in Necroking:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Become the Death Monarch.[/b] Command over 30 unique undead minions and crush anyone who stands against you. 
[*] [b]Vast Skull Deckbuilding. [/b]Customize your deck, unlock powerful unites, and devastate your enemies. 
[*] [b]4 diverse biomes.[/b] Each with its own deadly challenges and unique bosses. 
[*] [b]King’s Secret. [/b]Unravel the mystery of the King as you journey through a dark, twisted story. 
[/list]
You can already play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads, and we’re hard at work on adding full controller and Steam Deck support in upcoming updates. Stay tuned and join our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server to keep up with all the news!

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and leave feedback on Necroking – we can’t wait to hear what you think: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: KIngsgrave, a new game published by Alawar, is out now!
notes.content:
We're exited to introduce Kingsgrave, a gloomy adventure inspired by classic Zelda games. Gain more power and obtain new combat skills as you explore the fractured land, slay foes created by plague, solve puzzles and rebuild villages. Reclaim your realm! 

[previewyoutube=OmVzYrIJYAE;full][/previewyoutube]  

[b]What awaits you on this thorny path: [/b]
[list]
[*] Gather resources, reconstruct buildings, and restore subjects' houses, while defeating enemies to revive the realm and restore its prosperity. Your strength grows with each restoration, solidifying your reign as a wise monarch. 
[*] Slay plague creatures, purge the land of monsters, and sharpen your combat skills to protect your subjects and restore life to the wastelands. Equip yourself with powerful gear to overcome any foe. 
[*] Traverse forests, deserts, volcanoes, and catacombs in an interconnected world. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and navigate perilous terrain on a journey worthy of a true king.
[/list] 
The fate of the realm hangs in the balance, awaiting the guiding hand of a true sovereign. Will you answer the call and lead your people to triumph, or will you allow darkness to consume your lands? The choice, dear ruler, is yours to make. Let the legacy of Kingsgrave begin! 

Get the game with a 10% launch discount now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644360/Kingsgrave/

notes.title: News
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we released a [b]new update[/b] and we can’t wait to tell you all the details.

Most importantly, we’ve made it as simple as possible for players to form groups. It is now possible in the post-match screen to form a group with all other players at once, as well as only with those whose playstyle you like.

More details:
- The “Suggest forming a group” button has been added to the post-match screen. Once any player clicks this button, a group invitation is sent to the other players.
- You can also add a selected player to a group or to your Steam friends list. Just click their portrait on any in-game screen where you can see their avatar (the pause screen, the post-match screen, the main menu…).
- It’s now also possible to commend players for their in-game actions and behavior. Players who receive enough commendations over the last few days will have a special emblem in their avatar.
- We have changed the appearance of group invitations to make them less intrusive.

Some smaller, but still positive, changes:
- We’ve fixed some issues with unreadably small fonts and visual elements. The number of notes and jokes about this on our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/Tsp4WxZ][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229058/14def70420b85322320eb6bcf25bf0954bcbe10c.png[/img][/url] was a source of shame for us, so correcting this was a matter of honor.
- Bot behavior has been improved. A lot of changes have been made, but it wouldn’t be sporting in terms of AI to speak about them all in detail. In short – they’ll be making much fewer thoughtless and fatal mistakes, and will pose a much greater challenge to players.
- The issue has been fixed where (under specific, very strange and mysterious circumstances) the use of ultra-abilities uses up more Morale than it should.
- The graffiti feature has been tweaked. Sprays now stay on the map longer, but players can only spray one. Leave your mark in-game! Infected a terrified civilian around a corner somewhere? Show your smarts and cunning by leaving a picture beside them!
- We fixed and added 32 other minor things that don’t need their own explanations in this announcement, but are nevertheless designed to make the gaming experience more comfortable (for example, any changes to your Steam name will now be reflected in-game). You’re the ones who made these changes possible – we read every single one of your messages and do everything we can to address and implement everything (or almost everything) you suggest.
- We’ve fixed 14 minor technical bugs. These changes have been made to improve the quality of the game and minimize the number of situations where “something’s gone wrong”.

We hope you’ll be pleased with this update. The next one will come along very soon. We’re working on a few surprises for you.

Thank you all!

The Cheerdealers Team

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229058/6ab46c56ef9858137b7561b6681dd4d2ab3044e5.jpg[/img]

[url=https://s.team/chat/PQ6pWJeS][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229058/e99d1c0353609ed4aede1308ac31211591dc89c8.png[/img][/url]  [url=https://www.facebook.com/notamonstergame/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229058/d0673ff89619459f3d885c3c2de65e7a1ae16b1a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update- "Sandbox"
notes.content:
Dear friends.

We prepared a small update (third one already) that includes bugfix and improvements. We would like to share it with you:

The key point is a new game mode. We added [b]“Sandbox”[/b] mode to the list of “Quick” and “Rating” games:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229058/8a1674d5d42461329110ab9e39ea3d9add7469d8.png[/img]
[b]Sandbox mode[/b]
[list]
[*] You are the boss and this is the main rule! Such game mode was specially designed to follow your requests at the community. It gives you a possibility to try and feel all in-game mechanics along with unstoppable fun from the “Sandbox” mode itself! 
[*] You could choose your role (Monster or a Hunter). You could even play a Monster-only game – it’s up to you what would you and your friends prefer.
[*] Cheats were added. Now you could add any weapon, device or a combined hero ability and check it out.
[*] All planning phase limits are off! No need to hurry. You could review the detailed description for each device, ability or weapon and try it the way you want.
[*] You could play alone or together with your friends! Check it out – it could be really fun!
[/list]
Minor changes:

1)	We fixed the balance at [b]"Showdown"[/b] mode:
[list]
[*] Hero’s base is fulfilled with cool loot. Also, you could easily find a teleport there and move yourself to the Monster base using a secret bottom way.
[*] Monster base became less “equipped” because they move faster and can easily reach loot boxes.
[*] We reduced the number of EM Weapons at the map.
[/list]
2)	We fixed the balance at [b]"Cleansing"[/b] game mode:
[list]
[*] The activated ventilation system now infects a random person every two turns, not a once per turn. 
[*] Loot balance was changed. It would be easier for the Heroes to find a cool heroic ability and heal the infection.
[/list]
3)	We added a note on the number of real players which will join your upcoming session.

Last but not least:
[list]
[*] We added a voice chat volume configuration.
[*] Fixed the number of items used for some heroic abilities.
[*] Anti- cheater security level was improved  – nobody like cheaters.
[*] Fixed random issues with Guilt given for no reason.
[*] Fixed 63 more technical issues. Now you should experience way less lags, freezing and random unreasonable exits.
[/list]
Please, accept our apologies in case you experienced any of such issues at our game. Let us assure you that we hardly care about the quality of our game and are working on fixing any even “hidden” issues.

We really hope that you will enjoy this update while we will continue working on the single campaign, new monsters, new game modes and many more! 

Thanks in advance,
Yours, Cheerdealers!
